name: Nakhon Ratchasima

queries.query: Thailand official cadastral parcel map Nakhon Ratchasima Department of Lands map service
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Lands cadastral-map center and the official Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Land Office. The center advertises LandsMaps, the national cadastral parcel-search service; the local office page links LandsMaps and identifies the provincial land office as the local custodian. The LandsMaps host did not complete an anonymous HTTPS request in this environment.

queries.query: แผนที่โฉนดที่ดิน นครราชสีมา กรมที่ดิน ระบบแผนที่
queries.result: Thai-language first-party discovery identified the Department of Lands cadastral-map center and the Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Land Office. The local office page lists ค้นหารูปแปลงที่ดิน (LandsMaps) among public services. An official LDD ArcGIS service was reachable anonymously and exposes a point layer for land-parcel locations, but the bounded query at the required WUP point returned no feature and the layer is not a full parcel-polygon source.

researchNote: The Nakhon Ratchasima Provincial Land Office is a local registry/cadastre custodian evidenced by its official Department of Lands page, which links the public LandsMaps parcel-search service and provides the office identity. The Department of Lands cadastral-map center and LDD national map service are national sources. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
